summary: Strengthen AMIS price analysis, market-signal assessment, and decision briefs. Explore the five-day course outline and see if it fits your role.
lede: An agricultural market information system (AMIS) organizes market data for monitoring and analysis. This advanced training is for market analysts, commodity specialists, and food-security professionals who turn price and trade evidence into decision briefs. Participants practise comparing reference prices, assessing market integration, interpreting price movements, and making assumptions and uncertainty clear.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who already work with agricultural prices, commodity flows, or market intelligence and need to make their analysis more decision-ready.
audience: Food Security Analysts using market evidence
prerequisites: Working familiarity with agricultural commodity markets, price information, or market-monitoring tasks is expected. No coding or programming is required; basic spreadsheet use is helpful for the Excel exercises.
